source_texts: {i}The long-lost cousin, the bad news, the twenty-six hours of bus rides with countless late-night stops in seedy depots that would have felt unsafe even in the middle of the day. You wouldn’t normally find yourself traveling like this, but your cousin bought the tickets.{/i}

next_blocks.label: bus
source_texts: {i}The funeral of Pearlanne Scarlet— your cousin's mother and your aunt— seemed like something you shouldn't ignore, even considering your own late mother’s rocky relationship with this side of the family.{/i}
